name: selfportrait-studio-backend
description: Self-Portrait Studio — Express + Sequelize API with Supabase PostgreSQL

scripts.db:check: node -e "require('./src/config/database').authenticate().then(() => { console.log('DB connection OK'); process.exit(0); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.db:sync:safe: node -e "require('./src/models').sync().then(() => { console.log('DB synced safely'); process.exit(0); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
